dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, interconnected light-toned rings with jagged, high-contrast perimeters are visible. A prominent closed 'O' structure exists in the upper-mid dorsal region, while a larger, complex 'C' shaped cluster is situated centrally. Edges exhibit a sharp gradient from the dark exterior to a speckled, lower-intensity interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentrations of solid, high-intensity white pixel clusters are observed in the anterior-dorsal region near the neck and along the posterior-lateral margin. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as asymmetrical, localized patches.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three primary macro-annuli (upper-dorsal, central-lateral, and anterior-neck) form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest edge oriented approximately parallel to the dorsal midline.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly localized high-intensity point corresponding to the ocular region, surrounded by a low-intensity, uniform dark circular perimeter.
